title: venus-2006-world-heavyweight
label: Karla Starr

won.source: The fed's FAQ of 29 December 2006 says Karla Starr 'is listed as the first World Heavyweight champion straight off the bat' because she was the last New ERA Women's Champion; the date is the month the fed was created.

how: Instituted as the first champion when the women's division was made its own fed; no match is held.
note: The FAQ names her champion at creation. The fed's only show, B1TCHIN' 00, was unfinished at the last post; its main event, FOXX / STARR, is held in the mirror of the fed's host site and is a VENUS World Heavyweight Championship match, the first defense of the title, won by Starr.
